description: Import the four domain-neutral Mastery Advantage engine packages, migrate them from the implemented v2 baseline to the normative kst-srs.v3.2 contract, add portable persistence adapters, and make this monorepo the canonical shared runtime.
deviation_notes: S3 required a second Red/Green/review cycle to harden tenant identity, persistence parity, migration snapshots, and branch coverage. S4 added a dedicated runtime-compat package so packed-consumer and Codecamp proof gates remain reusable.

sprint.goal: Deliver a provider-neutral, app-neutral, v3.2-correct KST+SRS runtime that Codecamp can use as the first production vertical slice and every Advantage app can consume later.
